document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You can rent a car for a week. It is a rough drive upriver to Tell-
el-Amarna; a massive late flood of the Nile has closed both the 
railway and the regular passenger ship that runs up and down 
the river. The trip takes exactly 48 hours each way. 
If you drive to Tell-el-Amarna, go to 324. If you wish a 
translator guide to go with you, go to 108.
(384)
